notes: Explicit pilot configuration. This file does not authorize or initiate submission: optimize_sensitivity.py defaults to plan mode and only --execute submits or manages jobs.
Use a freshly built CMSSW_15_0_19_sensitivity_2d_v1.tar.gz archive; the new filename prevents accidental reuse of the older three-benchmark bundle.

One trial covers all 137 samples with at most one listed file and 10000 events per sample. With these limits it creates 137 worker tasks; one trial runs at a time. Sparse backgrounds and zero signal acceptance can still make calibration or optimization unsupported.
Keep the same file/event caps and ordered input lists for calibration and main optimization. Any expansion of the representative subset requires recalibration and a new reference.
Gate multiplicity and gate pT remain adjustable; AK4/AK8, collection pT, CA radius and thrust-assignment threshold retain the existing search ranges.
Four calibration trials are a bounded first cohort, not a guarantee that all114 positive references can be frozen.
